descriptions.user-company-office-mapping: Which company and which office each user may raise knitting entries against.
descriptions.machine-capacity-hour-plan: Declared hourly capacity per machine, and the plan the loading is built on.
descriptions.machine-profile: Gauge, diameter, feeder count and make of every knitting machine on the floor.
descriptions.assign-machine-operator: The operator posted to each machine, shift by shift.
descriptions.yarn-count-setup: Counts, blends and compositions every yarn record is built from.
descriptions.label-printer-setup: Printers and label formats used for roll and batch tags.
descriptions.sc-party-rate: Sub-contract knitting rates agreed per party, per fabric construction.

offices.hint: Pick a user, tick the company-and-office pairs they may work against, and save. A user with nothing ticked is unrestricted — the moment one pair is ticked they are confined to what is ticked.
offices.empty_title: Choose a user from the list
offices.empty: The full list of offices loads once a user is picked, with everything mapped today already ticked.
offices.no_offices: Add factories on Company Management first.
offices.footer: :selected of :count offices selected. Save writes the grid as it stands: pairs ticked since it loaded are granted, pairs unticked are revoked, and nothing else is touched.

capacity.hint: Bands do not overlap: one machine has one plan for any given day. Close the current band, or start the new one the day after it ends.
capacity.schedule_hint: Leave blank where the band applies whatever pattern the floor is running.
capacity.to_hint: Blank means the band is open-ended — the plan in force until another starts.
capacity.capacity_hint: Kilograms the machine gives in one running hour at 100%.

machine.hint: A machine is withdrawn rather than deleted once anything names it: clear Active?, and the record stays readable for whatever was knitted on it.
machine.no_hint: As it is painted on the machine — the whole floor calls it by this.
machine.country_hint: Where the machine was built, not who supplied it.
machine.gauge_hint: The gauge the machine is set to today. It must be one of the supported gauges below.
machine.supported_hint: Every gauge this cylinder can be re-needled to. Planning reads it to know whether a job could be moved here.

lists.intro: The four lists the machine form selects from — the kinds of machine, the makes, the cylinder diameters and the gauges. Pick a list to edit it, or add to it.
lists.empty: Its entries load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
lists.no_entries: Add the first one with Add entry above, then Save.
lists.footer: :count entries. An entry in use cannot be deleted — clear Active? instead, which withholds it from new machines while the ones already filed under it keep it. The Machines column counts everything pointing at the entry, a supported gauge included.

operator.hint: One live operator per machine per schedule. A posting that overlaps one already on file is refused — two answers to "who was running it" is the same as none.
operator.effective_hint: A time as well as a day: a night shift handed over at 22:40 is not the same fact as one handed over that morning.
operator.until_hint: Leave blank for the standing posting. Dating the next posting is what ends this one.
operator.machine_hint: Pick a machine to see who has been posted to it. Close a posting by dating it, or withdraw one raised in error — a change of operator is a new posting, not an edit to the last one.
operator.empty: Its postings load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
operator.no_postings: Post an operator on the New Assign tab.
operator.footer: :count postings. Date Until to close a posting; remove a line to withdraw a posting raised in error.

yarn.hint: A count in use is withdrawn rather than deleted: clear Active?, and every yarn already described by it stays readable.
yarn.no_hint: As the floor writes it. This is what the store's bin cards and the spinner's invoice both print.
yarn.desc_hint: The description printed wherever the count appears in a sentence.
yarn.value_hint: The count as a number, so counts can be sorted and banded. Blank where the figure is genuinely not known.
yarn.single_hint: Clear it for a plied yarn. A 30/2 is two 30s twisted together and knits nothing like a 30/1.

printer.hint: A printer with no users listed is offered to everyone. List one and it is offered only to those listed.
printer.name_hint: What the floor calls it. This is the name that appears in the print dialog.
printer.address_hint: The queue name or share the print client sends to. Nothing on the server opens it.
printer.users_hint: Tick the users this printer is offered to. None ticked offers it to everyone.
printer.auto_hint: Tick where the driver scales the label to the stock rather than printing at the design's own size.

master.machine_taken: There is already a machine with this number.
master.gauge_not_supported: The gauge must be one of the supported gauges.
master.to_before_from: Effective To cannot be before Effective From.
master.band_overlaps: This band overlaps one already on file for the machine. Close the current band, or start the new one the day after it ends.
master.posting_overlaps: This posting overlaps one already on file for the machine and schedule.
master.count_taken: There is already a count with this number.
master.printer_taken: There is already a printer with this name.
master.entry_in_use: An entry in use cannot be deleted — clear Active? instead.
master.one_primary: Only one office can be primary.

descriptions.yarn-purchase-requisition: Yarn raised against a booking, before it is turned into a purchase order.
descriptions.yr-pr-approve-list: Requisitions waiting on approval, and who each one is sitting with.
descriptions.comparative-statement: Supplier quotations set side by side before the order is placed.
descriptions.yarn-purchase-order: The placed order — count, quantity, rate and delivery schedule.

yarn.nothing: No records to choose from yet.

yr.list_hint: Nothing filled in lists the most recent requisitions. Add New opens the entry desk, where the yarn being asked for is written line by line.
yr.empty: No requisition matches. Press Add New to raise one, or widen the search above.
yr.entry_hint: The yarn an order needs, split into what will be bought locally and what will be imported. Submitting it from the register is what sends it for approval.
yr.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
yr.no_hint: The requisition number is issued when the form is first saved.
yr.store_hint: Where the yarn is to be received. The store the purchase order and the receipt will both quote.
yr.required_hint: When the floor wants the yarn. The date the approve list is worked in order of.
yr.lines_hint: One line per yarn item. Split the quantity between what will be bought locally and what will be imported — the total is their sum and is worked out for you.
yr.no_lines_hint: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
yr.foot: The requisition number is issued on save. A draft is rewritable; once it has been submitted for approval this form refuses it.

ap.title: YR/PR Approve List
ap.hint: Only requisitions waiting on a decision are listed. Approving one makes it orderable; rejecting it sends it back to the desk that raised it.
ap.note_hint: Carried onto whichever requisitions are approved or rejected next. A rejection with no reason is one nobody can answer.

cs.list_title: Comparison of Price Quatation for Purchase Order
cs.list_hint: Nothing filled in lists the most recent comparisons. Add New opens the comparison desk, where the requisition is picked and the spinners' offers are entered against its lines.
cs.empty: No comparison matches. Press Add New to raise one against an approved requisition.
cs.desk_hint: Lay the spinners' quotations against an approved requisition, line by line, and record which of them each line is being bought from.
cs.no_hint: The comparison number is issued when the sheet is first saved.
cs.requisition_hint: Approved requisitions only. Picking one from the list beside the form also fills the grid with its lines, their present stock and their open pipeline.
cs.req_date_hint: Copied from the requisition when the sheet is saved, so a comparison read months later still shows the paper it was raised from.
cs.details_hint: One row per yarn item. SL # is what the offers below are quoted against — leave it blank and the next free number is used. Total, and the quantity actually worth ordering, are worked out as the figures beside them are typed. Copy a row to split one item across two sources or two shipments.
cs.no_lines_hint: A comparison with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
cs.offers_hint: One row per spinner per line — the printed sheet's + button. SL # is the serial of the Details Data row the price is quoted against; Source says which of the two printed price bands it belongs to. A spinner quoting both local and import against one line is two rows.
cs.no_offers: No offer has been recorded yet. A comparison with no prices on it compares nothing, so at least one is needed before the sheet can be finalized.
cs.foot: The comparison number is issued on save. Finalising it — from the list — is what fixes which spinner each line is bought from, and a finalized sheet no longer takes edits.

po.list_hint: Nothing filled in lists the most recent orders. Add New opens the order desk, which is raised off a finalized comparison or straight against an approved requisition.
po.yr_hint: Matched against every requisition the order answers, not only the first.
po.empty: No purchase order matches. Press Add New to raise one, or widen the search above.
po.entry_hint: The order placed on a spinner — what is being bought, at what price, on what terms and against which requisition. Placing it from the list is what makes it receivable at the gate.
po.no_hint: The order number is issued when the form is first saved.
po.store_hint: Where the yarn is to be received. The store the gate will check the delivery into.
po.cs_hint: The finalized comparison this order comes off. Picking one from the list beside the form brings its lines across at the price they were agreed at.
po.yr_hint2: The requisition this order answers. Filled from the comparison when there is one; asked for here when the order is typed straight against a requisition.
po.conv_hint: To the ledger's own money, as at the day the order is placed. Held on the order so a rate that moves afterwards cannot restate it.
po.lines_hint: One line per yarn item bought. The amount is quantity times rate and settles as the two are typed; the store keeps the received column in step from its own receipts.
po.no_lines_hint: A purchase order with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
po.foot: The order number is issued on save. A draft is rewritable; once it has been placed on the supplier this form refuses it, because the store is receiving against those lines.

v.no_lines: A requisition that asks for no yarn asks for nothing.
v.line_yarn: Line :n names no yarn — pick its Yarn Item or Count.
v.line_qty: Line :n asks for no yarn — fill Local or Import.
v.locked: This requisition is :status — only a draft or one sent back is changed.
v.reject_note: A rejection with no reason is one nobody can answer.
v.cs_no_lines: A comparison with no yarn on it compares nothing.
v.sl_twice: Two lines carry the same SL #.
v.offer_sl: An offer is quoted against SL # :sl, which no line carries.
v.no_offers: A comparison with no prices on it compares nothing — record at least one offer before finalizing.
v.unfinalized: Pick the spinner each line is bought from before finalizing (SL # :sl).
v.cs_locked: :no is :status — a finalized or cancelled sheet takes no edits.
v.po_no_lines: A purchase order that buys nothing orders nothing.
v.po_line_qty: Line :n buys no yarn — fill its Qty.

ret_done.accept: :no accepted — the counted weight is back in stock.

pc_done.issue: :no issued — the yarn is off the store.
pc_done.reject: :no rejected — the yarn is back in stock.

rp_done.submit: :no submitted — the consignment is off the store.

ir.list_hint: Balance Qty is TTL Req. Qty − TTL Issue Qty. A requisition can be marked closed before it is fully issued — that is a decision, not an arithmetic result.
ir.empty: No yarn requisition matches that search
ir.entry_hint: What the floor is asking the store for. Each line is one count against one programme; KP Alloc is what the programme has reserved but not yet drawn.
ir.program_hint: Type the knit programme number to link this yarn to it. Linked yarn is what the process-loss and cost-per-kg reports set against the rolls knitted.
ir.lines_hint: Req. Qty is what is being asked for. KP Alloc is what the programme has already reserved against the store's stock — it is subtracted from the month's closing balance whether or not it has been drawn.
ir.no_lines_hint: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ir.foot: A requisition with yarn already issued against it cannot have its lines rewritten — issue the balance, or close it and raise a new one.

is.entry_hint: Issue yarn off the store against one requisition. Each line names the requisition line it answers, and the balance owed on that line comes down as it is saved.
is.req_hint: Only requisitions still open are offered. The company and store come from the requisition.
is.lines_hint: One line per requisition line answered. The lot is what actually left the rack, which is why it is typed here and not copied off the requisition.
is.no_lines_hint: A issue with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
is.foot: An issue cannot take a requisition line past what it asked for. Correcting an over-issue is a return, not an edit.
is.saved: :no saved — the yarn is off the store.
is.credited: yarn has come back against it

irr.empty: No yarn has been returned to the store yet.
irr.entry_hint: Unused yarn coming back off the floor. Ret is what was sent; Recv is what the store counted in — the two differ more often than anybody expects.
irr.lines_hint: Naming the issue line the yarn left on is what lets the store credit it. A line with no issue behind it is accepted, but it credits nothing and shows as an unmatched return.
irr.foot: Accepting the challan is done on the register — that is the moment the counted weight goes back into stock and the issue behind it is credited.

pw.empty: No yarn issue challan has been raised yet.
pw.entry_hint: Yarn going out of the store to a sub-contract party. The gate pass is written by security when the lorry leaves, so it stays blank until it does.
pw.lines_hint: One line per stock line leaving. The lot matters: what goes out on this paper is what the racking board stops counting as available.
pw.foot: A cancelled challan stays on file. The answer to a wrong one is a cancellation on the register, not a deletion here.

rp.empty: No yarn has gone back to a spinner yet.
rp.entry_hint: The consignment going back to a spinner against a replacement claim. One line per lot on the lorry.
rp.claim_hint: The replacement claim this consignment answers. Left blank for yarn going back ahead of the paperwork.
rp.lc_no_hint: The credit the lot came in under, when it was imported.
rp.lot_hint: The lot the consignment is against — what the register prints and what the spinner will quote back.
rp.lines_hint: One line per lot leaving the store. Cartons are what the gate counts; the weight is what the claim is settled on. The lot number is upper-cased, so two spellings of one lot cannot both exist on the paper.
rp.foot: Saving writes the challan as a draft. Submit and Accept are on the register — Accepted is the spinner's signature coming back, and it is what settles the claim behind the challan.

descriptions.issue-against-requisition: Yarn issued to a knitting program against an approved requisition.
descriptions.issue-return-against-requisition: Unused yarn returned to the store against the issue it left on.
descriptions.party-wise-yarn-issue-challan: Yarn issued out to a sub-contract party, party by party.
descriptions.issue-yarn-replace-by-supplier-list: Yarn the supplier is replacing, and what went out against it.
descriptions.yarn-opening: The yarn stock a new period opens with.
descriptions.process-loss-adjustment-yd: Dyeing process loss written off against the yarn issued.
descriptions.knitting-yd-statement: Yarn-dyed movement for the period, issue against receive.
descriptions.yarn-receive-challan-sc-in-house: Yarn received for in-house sub-contract knitting, on challan.
descriptions.dyed-yarn-receive-in-house: Dyed yarn coming back from the in-house dye house.
descriptions.yd-reprocess-in-house-to-yd-factory: Off-shade yarn sent back out of in-house stock for re-dyeing.
descriptions.yd-reprocess-sc-knitting-to-yd-factory: Yarn returned by a sub-contract knitter and routed on for re-dyeing.
descriptions.opening-balance: Store-wise opening balance per count, lot and shade.
descriptions.daily-receive: Yarn taken into the store today, against supplier challan.
descriptions.yarn-stock-racking-board: Rack and bin position of every lot held in the yarn store.
descriptions.daily-receive-return: Receipts reversed the same day — short, wet or off-count lots.
descriptions.yarn-month-closing: Locks the month's yarn movement and carries the balance forward.
descriptions.yarn-adjustment: Physical-count corrections booked against the yarn ledger.

op.title: Yarn Opening & Colosing Operation
op.hint: One store, one month. Adjustment and Reason of Adj are the only cells typed — every other figure is struck from the movements themselves, on this grid and again when it is saved.
op.pick_title: Choose a company, a store and a month, then press Search.
op.pick: Fill in the panel above and press Search.
op.foot: Reset is the Search button — nothing is held between builds, so re-running the search restores what is stored.
op.store_first: Choose a company and a store. A yarn ledger without a store in it is every store's stock added together.
op.closed: This month is closed — the grid is read only.
op.finalized_note: Finalised — the month's grid is signed for this store.
op.done: The month is finalised for this store.

ob.list_hint: Nothing filled in loads the most recent lines. The store's whole opening balance runs to tens of thousands of them, so each box narrows the query itself.
ob.empty: No opening balance line matches that search
ob.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
ob.entry_hint: The stock the yarn store is declared to hold. Pick a header on the left to correct one, or fill in a new Company Data block and add its lines.
ob.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ob.buyer_hint: Left blank for buffer stock, which is held against no particular order.
ob.lines_hint: One line per stock line — the yarn, whose brand, which lot. Total Qty is Pack Qty × Qty/Pack and TTL Value is Total Qty × Cost Price; both are worked out rather than typed.
ob.no_lines_hint: A opening balance with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ob.foot: Finalising a balance is done from the register. Until then its lines can be corrected here; afterwards they are what the store signed for.
ob.done_finalize: :no finalised — its stock is on the ledger.

mrr.list_hint: Nothing filled in loads the most recent receipts. Every box narrows the query itself, so a supplier with twenty thousand MRRs is still one page.
mrr.empty: No yarn receipt matches that search
mrr.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
mrr.entry_hint: Raise an MRR against a supplier's delivery. Pick a receipt on the left to correct one that has not been finalised, or fill in a new header and add its lines.
mrr.po_hint: Read only when Recv. Opt. is Receive By PO, and required then.
mrr.pi_hint: Read only when Recv. Opt. is Receive By PI, and required then.
mrr.ref_hint: The paper the receipt quotes — the PI's or PO's own reference, or the supplier's when nothing was ordered.
mrr.lines_hint: One line per stock line taken in. Qty is what the store actually counted; Challan Qty is what the supplier's paper claimed, so a short delivery is visible rather than argued about later.
mrr.no_lines_hint: A receipt with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
mrr.foot: A receipt keeps its own number, issued on save. The four desk checks — store, audit and accounts — are taken on the register, not here.
mrr.no_pi: No proforma invoice is on record yet.

done.cancel: :no cancelled — its yarn is off the ledger.
done.return: Return challan :no raised — trim it and issue it.

ret.title: Returns & Exchanges
ret.hint: Yarn refused at the desk. Pick the challan on the left, trim each line to what is going back, and save it as issued.
ret.challan_hint: Returnable means security should expect the same cartons back through the gate.
ret.lines_hint: Trim each line to what is actually leaving. A line set to zero is dropped from the challan.
ret.no_lines_hint: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ret.foot: A challan is raised from the register's Return or Exchange button. There is nothing to create here — only to trim and issue.
ret.issued: :no issued — the yarn has gone back.
ret.list_hint: Dates are inclusive of both ends. Leave everything blank to see the most recent returns.
ret.empty: No return challan matches that search

rack.board_hint: Rack Pending is Recv + Trns Recv. − Trns Sent − Return − Racked. Yarn is put away on the Rack Assignment tab, a receipt line at a time.
rack.empty: No stock line matches that search
rack.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
rack.assign_hint: Put received yarn away. Pick the rack and the weight going on it; what is left stays pending and comes back on the next search.
rack.pick_title: Choose a store, then press Search.
rack.pick: Fill in the panel above and press Search.
rack.assign_foot: Leave Rack Qty blank on a row to put the whole pending weight away at once.
rack.pick_rows: Give at least one row a Rack#.

mc.title: Yarn Store Month Closing
mc.hint: Show Exception lists what would stop the close without changing anything. Month Close applies the same checks again and strikes the month if they pass.
mc.finished: A month is closed after it has finished.
mc.none: No month has been closed yet. Pick a finished month above and press Show Exception to see what is outstanding in it.
mc.empty_hint: Change the search above and load again.
mc.clear: :month has nothing outstanding — it can be closed.

ex.issue_return: Not accepted — accept, reject or cancel it.
ex.party: Still a draft — issue or cancel it.
ex.replace: Still a draft — submit or cancel it.
ex.unfinished: The month has not finished yet.
ex.mrr: Still at Store Receive — verify or cancel it.
ex.ob: Not finalised — finalise it or remove it.
ex.return: Not issued — issue it or delete it.
ex.grid: The store moved yarn this month but its Yarn Opening Entry grid is not finalised.

adj.list_hint: Every correction booked against the ledger; a cancelled one has come back off it.
adj.entry_hint: Correct the ledger to what was physically counted: each lot up (+) or down (−). A lot never goes below what it holds.
adj.reason_hint: Why the count differs — it is printed on the adjustment.
adj.lines_hint: Pick the lot from the store's stock; Adjust Qty is the difference, positive to add, negative to take off.
adj.no_lines_hint: An adjustment with no lines corrects nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.

v.req_locked: :no has yarn issued against it — its lines cannot be rewritten.
v.req_no_lines: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.issue_returned: :no has yarn returned against it — correct it with a return, not an edit.
v.issue_req: Pick a requisition that is still open.
v.issue_no_lines: A issue with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.issue_line: Every line needs its Requisition Line.
v.issue_lot_pick: Every line needs the lot it leaves from.
v.issue_lot: Line :n names a lot not held in this store.
v.issue_lot_match: Line :n's lot is not the yarn its requisition line asks for.
v.issue_over: Line :n takes the requisition line past what it asked for (:left left).
v.issue_stock: Line :n takes more than the lot holds (:left).
v.ret_no_lines: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.ret_issue_line: Line :n names an issue line not on the requisition.
v.ret_over: Line :n brings back more than went out on its issue line (:left).
v.pc_no_lines: A issue challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.rp_no_lines: A challan with no yarn on it sends the spinner an empty lorry.
v.rp_lot_supplier: Line :n's lot came from another supplier.
v.month_closed: :period is closed — its yarn movement is locked.
v.store_and_company: Choose a company and a store. A yarn ledger without a store in it is every store's stock added together.
v.line_qty: Line :n takes no yarn — fill its quantity.
v.ob_no_lines: A opening balance with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.ob_finalized: :no is finalised — its lines are what the store signed for.
v.no_pi: No proforma invoice is on record yet — receive by PO or direct.
v.mrr_no_lines: A receipt with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.po_line: Line :n is not on the purchase order.
v.over_po: Line :n receives more than the order still owes (:left).
v.receipt_cancelled: A cancelled receipt has nothing to send back.
v.return_line: That line is not on the receipt.
v.return_more: Line :n sends back more than is held on it (:left).
v.return_stock: Line :n sends back more than the lot still holds (:left).
v.return_no_lines: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.return_issued: :no is issued — it can no longer change.
v.adj_no_lines: An adjustment with no lines corrects nothing.
v.adj_qty: Every line needs a non-zero Adjust Qty.
v.adj_lot: Line :n names a lot not held in this store.
v.adj_below: Line :n takes off more than the lot holds (:left).
v.rack_more: Row :n racks more than is pending (:left).
v.period_reason: Row :n has an adjustment without its Reason of Adj.
v.period_finalized: The month is finalised for this store — the grid is read only.
v.has_exceptions: :count exception(s) stop the close — press Show Exception to see them.

descriptions.fabric-current-stock: Grey fabric on hand right now, by order, construction and store.

descriptions.flatknit-report: Flat-bed output and collar/cuff delivery against requirement.
descriptions.daily-knitting-production-report: The day's production sheet — machine, order, shift and efficiency.
descriptions.mc-needle-loan-opening: Needles already out on loan when the register opens.
descriptions.mc-needle-loan-requisition: A request to borrow needles from or lend them to another party.
descriptions.mc-needle-receive: Needles taken into the store against a purchase or a return.
descriptions.mc-needle-opening-balance: Opening needle stock per type, gauge and machine.
descriptions.mc-wise-needle-assign: Needle types allotted to each machine as its standard fit.
descriptions.mc-wise-needle-broken: Breakage logged per machine — the number the store replaces against.
descriptions.mc-wise-needle-requisition: Needles asked for by a machine, against its breakage record.

hint.saved: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.

hint.sc_program: Only for sub-contract output: the out-house programme the pieces were knitted on.
hint.program_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent programmes. Received is what the store's collar/cuff challans have booked in against the programme, so it is a join rather than a figure anybody types.

hint.cpi: Courses per inch, as the party writes it.
hint.program_lines: One line per part the party is to knit. Size and gauge are on the line because a programme routinely covers several sizes of one collar.

hint.yarn_form: Pick the order on the left and its open flat-knit parts drop into the grid. Say which yarn each needs and how much, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.yarn_program: Set when the yarn is drawn for work placed on an outside party.
hint.yarn_lines_SOLID: One line per yarn the plan calls for — undyed or already-dyed stock the store holds against this order.
hint.yarn_lines_YD: One line per yarn-dyed shade the plan calls for. The lot matters here in a way it does not on the solid desk: two lots of one shade are two shades on a collar.
hint.yarn_foot: Saving writes a draft. Submit Requisition on the list is what sends it to the store, and approving it there is what lets yarn be issued against it.
hint.issue_desk: Approved requisitions on the left, the yarn each asks for on the right. Pick the stock line the store released from and the quantity; the requisition's standing follows it.
hint.challan_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent challans. Rcv Date is empty until the store signs for the challan — receiving it is what fills that column in and what puts the pieces onto the programme.
hint.challan_form: Pick the order on the left and its open flat-knit parts drop into the grid with what is still outstanding on each. Correct them to what is actually going, and save.
hint.from_floor: The flat-bed floor the pieces came off.
hint.challan_lines: One line per part on the paper. A line naming a requirement is what makes it count towards that requirement's delivery; a line naming none is stock moving for its own reasons.
hint.challan_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issue hands it to whoever is carrying the pieces; Receive at Store is the store counting them in, and that is what fills the Rcv Date column.

hint.saved: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.
hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.issued_on_save: Issued when it is first saved.
hint.locked: :no is :status — it can no longer be changed here.
hint.loan_opening_list: One position per party per item, carrying both directions — a party that lent us some and borrowed some back has one net account, not two.
hint.loan_opening: Needles already out on loan when the register opens.
hint.category: Narrows the item list below it. The position is held against the item.
hint.loan_received: Lent to us by this party, and not yet given back.
hint.loan_issued: Lent by us to this party, and not yet returned.
hint.cost_price: What the needles were valued at when the book opened.
hint.is_final: Both sides have agreed the figure. A finalised position stops being editable.
hint.opening_list: Every opening sheet, per store and date. A finalised sheet is in the book and can no longer be changed.
hint.opening: Pick the company, the store and the opening date, press Load, and the store's needles come up with whatever has already been entered against them.
hint.ob_category: Narrows the grid. Leave it blank to type a whole shelf at once.
hint.ob_load: Pick a company, a store and an OB date, then press Load. The sheet is per store and per date, because that is what the count was of.
hint.ob_zero: A line left at zero is not stored — a zero opening and no row at all are the same fact. Load re-reads the sheet from the database.
hint.ob_finalized: This sheet is finalised: its stock is in the book and it can no longer be changed.
hint.assign_list: Every unit and category with machines fitted. A finalised fit is the machine's standard and can no longer be changed.
hint.assign: Pick a unit and a category, press Load, and every machine on that unit comes up with the item it is fitted with and how many.
hint.assign_load: Pick a unit and a category, then press Load. One row per machine within a category — a machine's needle and its sinker are two loads of this screen.
hint.fit_zero: A machine left with no item or a quantity of zero is not assigned — clearing the box is how a fit is taken off.
hint.fit_finalized: This fit is finalised: it is the machines' standard and can no longer be changed.
hint.closing: Show Exception lists what would stop the close without changing anything. Start Closing applies the same checks again and strikes the month if they pass — a store with unfinalised paper in the window is skipped rather than closed over.
hint.closing_date: The month this date falls in is the one Start Closing strikes. Leave it blank to strike each store's next due month.
hint.receipt_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent receipts. Item Name matches the needle code as well as its description, because the store quotes the part number.
hint.receipt_form: Fill in the delivery and the paper it came on, list the needles under it, and saving books the receipt in as a draft.
hint.receipt_store: The needle store the delivery was taken into.
hint.lc_no: An import only. A local receipt has no letter of credit behind it.
hint.receipt_lines: One line per needle or sinker. Challan Qty is what the supplier's paper claimed; Received Qty is what the store counted — they disagree often enough to be worth both.
hint.receipt_status: Draft — verified and approved from the receive list.
hint.receipt_foot: Saving writes a draft. Verify, Accounts Approve and Finalize on the list are what move it; Verify is the store counting it in, and once it has left the store's desk the lines can no longer be changed here.
hint.consumption: What the store took in and let go of, needle by needle, between two dates. Every column is summed from the documents themselves.
hint.consumption_store: Pick a store, then press Show. The board is per store, because a needle sitting on one shelf is not stock on another.
hint.return_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent return challans. A challan is raised from the receipt it answers — either from the Raise Return button on the receive list, or on the entry desk beside this one.
hint.return_form: Pick the delivery the needles came in on, trim the quantities going back, and saving writes the challan as a draft.
hint.return_mrr: A return always answers a receipt — pick one on the left and its lines come across.
hint.rtn_challan: Left blank, the desk numbers it after the receipt — NMR-…-R01.
hint.return_type: Returnable means the goods are expected back through the gate — sent for servicing, or swapped.
hint.return_lines: The receipt's outstanding lines. Trim Return Qty to what is actually going back — a line set to zero is left alone.
hint.return_status: Draft — issued at the gate and finalised from the return list.
hint.return_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issue at Gate is what moves the store's balance, and it is on the list — the receipt's returned quantity moves with it, so the two can never disagree.
hint.broken_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent shifts. Qty and Cost Price are summed from the machines on each record, so a line corrected on the entry desk moves both.
hint.broken_form: Say which unit, machine type, date and shift the sheet covers, list the machines that broke needles on it, and saving writes the record as a draft.
hint.office_machines: Narrows the machine list on the grid below.
hint.machine_type: Left blank when the sheet covers a mixed floor.
hint.broken_lines: One line per machine and needle. A machine that broke a cylinder needle and a sinker on the same shift has two lines.
hint.broken_status: Draft — confirmed from the breakage list.
hint.broken_foot: Saving writes a draft. Confirm on the list is the supervisor signing the count, and a machine-wise requisition can only be raised against a confirmed record.
hint.req_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent requisitions. Rqd, Iss and Balance are summed from the lines, so an issue raised on the issue list moves all three at once.
hint.req_form: Say which store is asking which, why, and against what breakage; list the machines and the needles they need, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.broken_confirmed: Confirmed records only. A store replacing against an unsigned count is replacing against a number nobody has agreed.
hint.from_store: The store raising the request — usually the unit's sub-store.
hint.to_store: The store being asked to release the needles — usually the main store.
hint.req_lines: One line per machine and needle. Iss.Qty is not on this grid: what is released is written on the issue desk, against this requisition.
hint.req_status: Draft — submitted and verified from the requisition list.
hint.req_foot: Saving writes a draft. Submit and Verify on the list are what move it; once it has been verified the lines can no longer be changed here, and what is released against it is written on the issue desk.
hint.issue_list: Every issue raised against a verified requisition, with the requisition's standing beside it. Withdraw takes a release back off the book.
hint.issue_form: Pick the requisition being answered, trim what is actually being released, and saving writes the issue and moves the requisition's Iss.Qty with it.
hint.issue_req: An issue always answers a requisition — pick one on the left and its outstanding lines come across.
hint.issue_lines: The requisition's outstanding lines. Trim Iss.Qty to what the store is actually releasing — a line set to zero is left owing.
hint.issue_status: Issued — the requisition's Iss.Qty moves with this document.
hint.issue_foot: Saving an issue moves the requisition's Iss.Qty and its status in the same transaction, so the two can never disagree. Withdrawing an issue takes the release back off.
hint.loan_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent requisitions. Required, Issued and Balance are summed from the lines, so a line corrected on the desk moves all three at once.
hint.loan_form: Fill in who is asking and what for, list the needles under it, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.kind: Which way the needles are going. It cannot be changed once the requisition is saved.
hint.loan_store: The needle store being asked to release them.
hint.loan_lines: One line per needle or sinker. Issue Qty is what the store has actually released against the line — leave it at zero until it has.
hint.loan_status: Draft — submitted and verified from the requisition list.
hint.loan_issuing: Verified — only the Issue Qty column may be changed here; saving posts what the store has released.
hint.loan_foot: Saving writes a draft. Submit and Submit & Verify on the list are what move it; once it is verified only the Issue Qty column may be changed here.
hint.lo_list_NEEDLE: Needles requisitioned to be lent out to a party, and what it still owes. Required, Issued and Balance are summed from the lines; Returned is what the party has handed back on received return challans.
hint.lo_list_OIL: Oil requisitioned to be lent out to a party, and what it still owes. Required, Issued and Balance are summed from the lines; Returned is what the party has handed back on received return challans.
hint.lo_form_NEEDLE: Fill in who is asking and what for, list the needles under it, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.lo_form_OIL: Fill in the party the oil is being lent to, list what is going out, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.lo_store_OIL: The store being asked to release the oil.
hint.lo_lines_OIL: One line per oil. Issue Qty is what the store has actually released against the line — leave it at zero until it has.
hint.lb_list_NEEDLE: Nothing filled in loads the most recent return challans. RCV Date stays empty until the store counts the needles in — receiving is what fills it, and what puts the quantity back onto the requisition the loan went out on.
hint.lb_list_OIL: Nothing filled in loads the most recent return challans. RCV Date stays empty until the store measures the oil in — receiving is what fills it, and what puts the quantity back onto the requisition the loan went out on.
hint.lb_form: Fill in the party's return challan and list what came back on it. Saving writes the challan as a draft.
hint.lb_req_NEEDLE: The loan issue the needles went out on. Receiving the challan takes its quantity back off that requisition's balance.
hint.lb_req_OIL: The loan issue the oil went out on. Receiving the challan takes its quantity back off that requisition's balance.
hint.lb_receiver_NEEDLE: Who at the store counted the needles in. Required before the challan can be received.
hint.lb_receiver_OIL: Who at the store measured the oil in. Required before the challan can be received.
hint.lb_lines_NEEDLE: One line per needle or sinker coming back. Received Qty is what the store counted — leave it at zero and receiving the challan fills it in from the paper.
hint.lb_lines_OIL: One line per oil coming back. Received Qty is what the store measured — leave it at zero and receiving the challan fills it in from the paper.
hint.lb_status: Draft — received at the store and finalised from the return list.
hint.lb_foot_NEEDLE: Saving writes a draft. Receive at Store on the list is what counts the needles in, dates the challan and takes the quantity off what the party still owes.
hint.lb_foot_OIL: Saving writes a draft. Receive at Store on the list is what measures the oil in, dates the challan and takes the quantity off what the party still owes.
hint.lr_list_NEEDLE: Borrowed needles requisitioned to be sent back to the party they came from. Required, Issued and Balance are summed from the lines.
hint.lr_list_OIL: Borrowed oil requisitioned to be sent back to the party it came from. Required, Issued and Balance are summed from the lines.
hint.lr_form_NEEDLE: Fill in who is asking and what for, list the needles under it, and saving writes the requisition as a draft. Nothing more can go back than was borrowed from that party.
hint.lr_form_OIL: Fill in the party the borrowed oil is going back to, list what is being sent, and saving writes the requisition as a draft. Nothing more can go back than was borrowed from that party.
hint.lrc_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent receipts. Outstanding is what the factory has still to hand back — received less returned, line by line.
hint.lrc_form_NEEDLE: Fill in the challan the needles arrived on and list them under it. Saving writes the receipt as a draft.
hint.lrc_form_OIL: Fill in the challan the oil arrived on and list it under it. Saving writes the receipt as a draft.
hint.lrc_pay: Adjustment is the usual one: nothing changes hands, the quantity is squared against what the other side owes.
hint.lrc_lines_NEEDLE: One line per needle or sinker borrowed. Returned Qty is what has since gone back to the lender — the register's Outstanding column is this less that.
hint.lrc_lines_OIL: One line per oil borrowed. Returned Qty is what has since gone back to the lender — the register's Outstanding column is this less that.
hint.lrc_status: Draft — verified by the store and approved by accounts from the receive list.
hint.lrc_foot: Saving writes a draft. Submit, Verify and Accounts Approve on the list are what move it — Verify is the store counting it in. An L/C number belongs on an import and is refused on a local receipt.
hint.loan_opening_OIL: Oil already out on loan when the register opens. One position per party per item, carrying both directions — a party that lent us some and borrowed some back has one net account, not two.
hint.cost_price_OIL: What the oil was valued at when the book opened.
hint.oil_req_list: Oil asked for by the floor against machine running hours. Required, Issued and Balance are summed from the lines, so a line corrected on the desk moves all three at once.
hint.oil_req_form: Fill in which store is asking which, list the oil under it, and saving writes the requisition as a draft.
hint.oil_issuing: Verified: only Issue Qty can change now. Saving it releases the oil from the store asked into the store asking.
hint.oil_to_store: The store being asked to release the oil.
hint.oil_req_lines: One line per oil. Issue Qty is what the store has actually released against the line — leave it at zero until it has.
hint.oil_req_status: Draft — submitted and verified from the requisition list
hint.oil_req_foot: Saving writes a draft. 13-Submit and 14-Verify & Submit R on the list are what move it; once it is verified only the Issue Qty column may be changed here.
hint.oil_opening_list: One line per store, item and opening date. Finalising is on the row and on the opening sheet tab — a finalised line stops being editable, because a starting point that can still move is not a starting point.
hint.oil_sheet: Load the store's opening lines, tick the ones the count agrees with, and Finalize All signs the page off.
hint.oil_ob_form: The oil stock a new period opens with, per grade and drum.
hint.oil_ob_final: This opening line is finalized — it can no longer be changed.
hint.oil_ob_category: Narrows the item list beside it. The balance is held against the item.
hint.oil_unit_price: What the supplier invoiced, in the currency beside it.
hint.oil_conv_rate: What that currency was worth in the ledger's own on the opening date.
hint.oil_cost_price: Struck on save from the two boxes above it, so a page reprinted after a rate change still shows the arithmetic it was signed on.
hint.oil_cons_list: Oil drawn per machine per day, against its running hours. Requisition Date matches one day exactly; From and To take a window. Qty is summed from the machine lines.
hint.oil_cons_form: Fill in the shift the sheet covers, list the machines that drew oil on it, and saving writes the sheet.
hint.oil_issue_by: Who at the store handed the oil over. Required before the sheet can be finalised.
hint.oil_cons_lines: One line per machine and oil. Running Hrs is what the machine ran on the shift — it is the denominator the floor reads consumption over.
hint.oil_cons_status: Open — finalised from the consumption list
hint.oil_cons_foot: One sheet per store, date and shift. Saving leaves it open; Finalize on the list is the supervisor signing for it — the oil leaves the store then, and a finalised sheet stops being editable.
hint.oil_receipt_list: Nothing filled in loads the most recent receipts. RCV Qty and Cond. Qty are summed from the lines; Exchangable/Returnable is what is left after anything already sent back.
hint.oil_receipt_form: Fill in the challan the drums arrived on and list what was measured in.
hint.oil_receipt_req_type: A receipt nobody can trace to a requisition is a receipt nobody can check a price against.
hint.oil_receipt_lines: One line per oil. Challan Qty is what the supplier's paper claimed and RCV Qty what the store measured; Cond. Qty is the part of it accepted pending a test result.
hint.oil_receipt_status: Draft — signed for by QC, the store and accounts from the receive list
hint.oil_receipt_foot: Saving writes a draft. Send to Next Desk, Finalize and Accounting Done on the list are what move it — Finalize is the store saying the lines are right, and the oil is booked in then. An L/C number belongs on an import and is refused on a local receipt.
hint.oil_return_list: Receipts reversed — wrong grade, short measure or leaking drums. Issuing a return challan is what takes its quantity off the receipt it was raised against.
hint.oil_return_form: Pick the receipt the oil came in on, list the lines going back, and saving writes the challan as a draft.
hint.oil_return_mrr: The receipt the oil came in on. Its company, store and supplier are copied onto the challan.
hint.oil_return_type: Returnable is oil going out that will come back — sent for testing, or swapped. Non-returnable is oil the supplier is credited for and keeps.
hint.oil_return_lines: One line per receipt line going back. The dropdown shows how much of each is still returnable after anything already sent.
hint.oil_return_status: Draft — issued and finalised from the return list
hint.oil_return_foot: The company, store and supplier come from the receipt. Issue on the list is what sends the drums out and takes their quantity off the receipt.

hint.knitting: Every report on this list is run against the same three boxes. Yarn Item narrows the yarn reports, YR Approve? narrows the requisition ones, and Date Type says which of a document's dates the window applies to.
hint.yarn-store: Every report here is dated. Leave both boxes blank for everything on file — a stock report ignores the dates, because a balance is as at now rather than over a period.
hint.gfs: Buyer A/C, Style/Order#, Production Type and Store narrow whichever of them the chosen report reads. A parameter a report does not take simply does not narrow it.
hint.qc: Fourteen boxes, all of them optional. Roll List Without Grey QC is the one report here that answers with rolls having no inspection at all, so the QC Status and QC Grade boxes do not narrow it.
hint.flatknit: The flat-knit floor counts in pieces; only the yarn requisition report is in kilograms. Req. Type narrows that one to Solid or Y/D.
hint.yarn-stock: Stock is struck from every document that has moved the line — opening balance, receipts, issues, returns, dyed-yarn receipts, party challans and approved adjustments. Alloc is what an open requisition has reserved; Stock is what is left free.
hint.grey-stock: Today Rcv. Qty counts what the store took in on the To date; Total Rcv. Qty is everything in the window. Due for Prod. Qty is the order's target less what the floor has knitted, so fabric still on the machine counts.
hint.daily-output: The DAY and NIGHT columns split on the mill's own 08:30 boundary, taken from the shift pattern a roll was logged under and from the time on the scale where there is none. A rejected roll is knitted but not production, so it is left out of both.

hint.receipt_list: The grid opens on every challan booked in from an outside knitter, most recent first.
hint.receipt_form: Grey fabric — and collar or cuff — arriving from an outside knitter, booked against the party's own challan.
hint.rcv_no: Issued when the challan is first saved.
hint.party_out: The outside knitter the fabric came from.
hint.store_rcv: Where the fabric was put. Required before the challan can be received.
hint.receipt_lines: One line per roll or lot on the party's challan. Fabric is counted in kilograms; collar and cuff in pieces.
hint.receipt_foot: Saving writes a draft. Receiving it on the register is what books the fabric in and puts it on the QC worklist.
hint.qc: Only challans carrying collar or cuff appear here — those are the lines held for inspection.
hint.ret_list: The grid opens on this screen's own return challans, most recent first.

ret_form.OUT_HOUSE: Grey fabric going back to an outside knitter — against a rejection, or against fabric they sent in error.
ret_form.IN_HOUSE: Grey fabric returned within the in-house sub-contract arrangement — a movement between two floors of the same site.

hint.party_ret: The party the fabric is going back to.
hint.store_ret: The store the fabric is leaving.

against.OUT_HOUSE: The receive challan this fabric came in on, when the return answers one.
against.IN_HOUSE: The party's programme receipt this fabric was knitted against, when the return answers one.

hint.ret_lines: One line per roll or lot going back. Picking a roll fills the line in and lets the issue move it out of the store; a line with no roll is a quantity that moves nothing.
hint.ret_foot: Saving writes a draft. Issuing it on the register is what takes the rolls out of the store; until then the fabric has not moved.
hint.delivery_list: The grid opens on every delivery challan, most recent first.
hint.delivery_form: One paper for one lorry: the fabric going out, the collar and cuff going with it, and the party's unused yarn going back.
hint.party_delivery: The in-house party the fabric is being delivered to.
hint.fabric_lines: One line per roll going out. Picking a roll fills its fabric, shade, dia, gauge and net weight — correct the weight only if the gate weighed it differently.
hint.collar_lines: Collar and cuff going with the fabric, counted in pieces rather than kilograms.
hint.yarn_lines: The party's leftover yarn going back with the lorry — item, shade and lot, because that is how a store counts a cone.
hint.delivery_foot: Saving builds the challan. Issuing it on the register is what takes the rolls out of the store — until then the fabric has not moved.
hint.existing: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
hint.locked: :no is :status, so it can no longer be edited here.

empty.receipt_lines: A receive challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
empty.return_lines: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
empty.fabric: No fabric on this challan yet. A delivery may carry collar/cuff or yarn alone, so this grid is allowed to stay empty.
empty.collar: No collar or cuff on this challan.
empty.yarn: No yarn going back on this challan.

done.receive: :no received — the fabric is in the store.
done.issue: :no issued — the rolls are out of the store.

v.challan_no: Challan# is required — it is the party's own number.
v.qty: Qty must be more than nothing.
v.no_receipt_lines: A receive challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.no_return_lines: A return challan with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.no_delivery_lines: A delivery challan with nothing on it — no fabric, collar/cuff or yarn — sends nothing.
v.challan_taken: The party's challan :no is already booked in.
v.store_first: Pick the store the fabric was put in before receiving the challan.
v.receipt_used: :no cannot be cancelled: some of its fabric has already left the store.
v.against_party: That receive is not this party's.
v.line_store: Line :n is not held in the chosen store.
v.roll_twice: Line :n takes a roll already on this challan.
v.line_over: Line :n takes more than the store holds (:have).
v.yarn_lot: Line :n needs the yarn lot going back.
v.yarn_party: Line :n's yarn is not this party's.
v.yarn_short: Yarn lot :lot no longer holds that much.
